01

Three Aesthetics links lead to 404 pages

The Aesthetics page offers Facial Aesthetics, Botox and Dermal Fillers, but all three linked service URLs return 404, leaving visitors without those service details.

  • Point each tile to a verified live matching page, or remove the tile until its page is published.
  • For any replaced URL with a real successor, add an exact 301 redirect and retest the tile and destination.

02

Friday hours conflict on the site and Google

Several service pages say the office is closed Friday, their hours table says Friday 8 a.m.–1 p.m., and the exact Google Business Profile says 9 a.m.–1 p.m.

  • Use the GBP schedule as the website source: Monday–Thursday 8 a.m.–5 p.m., Friday 9 a.m.–1 p.m., weekends closed.
  • Correct the closed-Friday copy and the 8 a.m.–1 p.m./8 a.m.–noon website hours wherever they appear.
Exact GBP listing

Google profile
03

Business schema describes conflicting locations

The homepage publishes three Dentist entries, including one coordinate about 1.7 km from the verified Google pin, plus an Organization contact number that differs from the public main phone.

  • Keep one accurate Dentist entity for this office, using the verified address, coordinates and main phone.
  • Confirm what the other contact number is for before changing it; update repeated rating data if it is retained.

04

Hero discovery is late; two lower sections load 3.9 MB

The first-screen hero is the LCP element but its CSS background is discovered late, while the lower Meet Dr. Natalie and Services sections immediately fetch two large backgrounds totaling 3.9 MB.

  • Make the hero background discoverable and high-priority in the initial page load; keep the critical first-screen styles available.
  • Compress and defer the two below-screen backgrounds, then retest LCP and transfer weight; review first-load scripts without breaking tracking or widgets.

05

The blog hub is hard to reach from the site

The 58-page sitemap includes a blog hub and 22 posts, but the homepage link crawl did not reach the hub, leaving this educational content outside the main navigation path.

  • Add a crawlable Blog or Resources link in a suitable menu or footer location.
  • Keep educational articles focused on their questions, with only natural links to relevant treatment pages.
Site-link crawl
58 sitemap pages returned 200 and self-canonical
Homepage link graph reached 34 indexable HTML pages, not /blog/
/blog/ itself links to its posts; the posts are not individually missing
Blog hub
06

Payment details depend on the embedded widget

The Cherry financing widget works for visitors, but the Payment Plans page initially supplies only a heading and hero in its own HTML and has no meta description.

  • Add short page-native copy covering available options, eligibility caveat and the next step, plus a specific meta description.
  • Keep live rates and terms inside the provider widget rather than copying figures that may change.

Fix order

Start with broken routes and contradictory business information, then reduce first-load weight and improve crawlable page paths.

  • First: resolve the three 404 links and confirm/correct office hours and business schema.
  • Next: optimize mobile assets, connect the blog hub, and strengthen the Payment Plans page.

Read-only audit. Mobile speed comes from variable lab tests without CrUX field data; GBP is used as the hours source by request but the practice schedule was not independently confirmed. This is not a Google penalty or overall SEO score.
